messages:
incident-bot: :warning: Pager: spike in gateway 5xx and 429 responses in region-us-west-2. Triggered by gateway-errors group at 1789994322.

mia: Oncall here, I'm digging into ingress and rate-limiter panels.

samir: I see a big uptick in 429s from rl-service starting ~1789994280. Linking dashboard: https://metrics.redwood/gateway/rl-spike?from=1789994200

lee: Traces show clients retrying aggressively, then hitting model-frontends which are reporting connection timeouts and 502s. Likely cascade from throttling.

ops-bot: Recent config-rollout detected: rollout-id=cfg-2026-0315-x scope=org initiated-by=olivia completed at 1789994275

mia: Who rolled that out? olivia? can you confirm the change?

olivia: I ran a canary earlier to lower debug rate caps for model-serving to 300rpm for troubleshooting. I thought it was scoped to canary nodes only.

samir: If that debug cap applied org-wide, it would produce mass 429s and force clients to retry, spiking model load and producing 5xx. Need immediate mitigation.

mia: Mitigation options: 1) undo rollout, 2) increase cap quickly, 3) add retry suppression/circuit-breaker on gateway to limit amplification. Which is fastest?

olivia: Undo is fastest. Starting rollback: `cfgtool rollback cfg-2026-0315-x --scope org`

ops-bot: Rollback job queued rb-9001 ETA ~45s

support-bot: Support: multiple customers reporting failures. Notifying CS. Preparing holding message for status page.

samir: While rollback executes, I'm pushing a temporary gateway rule: `gateway.retries.max=1` and `gateway.cb.window=15s` to reduce repeated hits to model pool.

mia: Also enable short-term per-client token backoff so big clients get rate-limited client-side. Samir, can you apply that?

samir: Applying now. Config patch sent to frontends.

ops-bot: Rollback complete at 1789994370. cfgtool status: undone.

olivia: Confirming rate-limit metrics rolling back to baseline.

ops-bot: Metric update: 429s down 70% from peak, 5xx down 60% from peak.

mia: Any tenants still having trouble? Support?

support-bot: Tenant-42 still at ~15% error rate, heavy batch embedding requests. Support thread: internal link.

olivia: For Tenant-42, we can issue a short-lived bypass to route them to reserved capacity: `auth create-bypass --tenant Tenant-42 --ttl 45m` done and applied to routing rules.

samir: After bypass, their success rate improved to ~99% within a minute. Traces show reduced queueing on model-workers.

mia: Good. Next steps: root cause and follow-ups. Draft: rollout templating mis-specified canary scope and promoted debug override to org/global scope. That caused low per-service cap to be enforced globally -> 429s -> client retries -> backend saturation and 5xx. Also gateway retry policy amplified impact.

olivia: Filed ticket INFRA-4923 "canary-scope leakage in config rollout" and opened PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/523 for validation checks.

samir: Action items:
- olivia: add stricter rollout-scope validation and automated preflight (owner: olivia, ETA 24h)
- samir: add retry-budget enforcement + autoscaling guardrails on frontend (owner: samir, ETA 48h)
- mia: run chaos/canary tests to simulate scope leaks (owner: mia, ETA 72h)
- support: customer comms and credits (owner: support-bot/SRE support lead, ETA 2h)

support-bot: Posted status page: "We experienced elevated errors in US-West impacting a subset of customers between 17:00-17:18 UTC. Mitigation applied and traffic stabilized. A follow-up postmortem will be published."

mia: Declaring incident Sev2. Scheduling postmortem tomorrow 16:00 UTC. Please attach logs, traces, and timeline to INFRA-4923.

samir: I'll upload flamegraphs and heap snapshots to the ticket and include sampling spans showing retry amplification.

olivia: After-action note: will not run org-scoped debug overrides without explicit canary gating; adding CLI safety check.

mia: Final check - current metrics: 5xx near baseline, 429s minimal. Logging final snapshot.

ops-bot: Final metric snapshot: peak window 1789994300-1789994380, 5xx peaked +220%, returned to baseline +3%; 429 peaked +140%, returned to baseline +2%.

mia: Thanks everyone. Keeping this thread open until postmortem artifacts are attached. Re-pager if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
